meta.name: website-finishing-director
meta.description: Run a structured 5-pass finishing audit on any website before launch — scoring visual polish, technical foundation, UX completeness, content quality, and cross-device readiness on 100 points. Use when: **Pre-launch** - Final validation before going live; **Post-redesign** - Verify nothing broke during the overhaul; **Client handoff** - Structured proof that the site is ready; **Quarterly review** - Catch accumulated debt; **Single-pass focus** - Run just Pass 2 after a perf sprint

copy.tagline: 上线前对网站做五轮质量审计并打分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在网站发布前系统性地检查视觉、技术、UX、内容和跨设备质量。
